name: avian-ui-assets
description: Builds the bundled Tiptap script for <x-avian::editor>. The package itself needs no build step.

scripts.build:editor: esbuild resources/js/editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2019 --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/*! Avian UI editor bundle: Tiptap (MIT, überdosis GbR), ProseMirror (MIT, Marijn Haverbeke and others), linkifyjs (MIT, Hypercontext). Built from resources/js/editor.js. */" --outfile=public/js/avian-ui-editor.js
